title: Tenma Tsukasa — Meat Gives You Energy!〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Beach

rows.Speaker: Film Crew
rows.Line:
That's all for this morning!
We'll resume shooting after lunch!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Understood!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Phew... We managed to get through the morning in one piece.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, I got pretty worried when it started raining. I was sure we were gonna get delayed because of it...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
But it cleared up really fast!
And we get to have lunch pretty much right on time☆

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: However, because it didn't go as planned yesterday, we'll be doing the airport scene again this afternoon...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Right...
I hope things go better today...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: At this point, all we can do is place our faith in Mr. Ohara and Rui.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
And since we'll be switching locations...
We need to somehow clean and pack everything up right after we finish having lunch.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Which means we may want to do that first and then eat.

rows.Speaker: Film Crew
rows.Line:
Hey, you guys, feel free to eat now!
The rest of us will start cleaning and packing!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait, are you sure...?

rows.Speaker: Film Crew
rows.Line:
Yeah, don't worry!
Come help us once you've finished eating!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Understood! Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Well, if they're saying that it's okay... Then let's eat while we can.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Okay☆
I can't wait to see what's for lunch today♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, me neither!
And it's so nice how we get different choices each day.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Nene, weren't you in charge of laying them out today?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, our choices today are...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Sandwiches, Salisbury steak, seasoned rice and... Oh, there was also a barbeque lunch.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What?! Barbeque?! That sounds delicious!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It's just what I need to recharge my batteries for our shoot this afternoon!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I might get the Salisbury steak♪
But I could really go for some sandwiches too...! Hmm... I can't choose!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Relax... You haven't even had a chance to look at them yet.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: While we're on the subject, is Rui remembering to get a lunch too? It's been quite a while since he went over to talk to Mr. Ohara...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, I think that's him over by that tent. It looks like he and Mr. Ohara are still talking...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I actually just passed by there a second ago. You should've seen how wrinkled both their brows were...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I see. Which likely means that scene's still giving them trouble...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: To be fair, it is the climax.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But he must be pretty hungry after moving around all morning. Why don't we personally deliver his lunch to him?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wow☆ It always looks like we're having a feast!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, I was completely stunned when I first saw a tower of lunches stacked up like this, but it feels completely normal now.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, I couldn't believe it either.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, Tsukasa! They have one barbeque lunch left!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
What?! Just one?!
I must secure it...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
It says it's chock-full of meat!
I bet you'll feel powered up after eating it☆

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Agreed! It's just what I need to keep working hard this aftern—

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Powered up, huh...?)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Is something wrong, Tsukasa?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
No, um...
If this lunch packs such a powerful punch...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Then, I feel like it should go to Rui instead of me.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah...
His brain's gonna need fuel to come up with good ideas.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Right! This should help him do that, and I'm sure he's super duper hungry!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Exactly.
So, let's go give this to Rui.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Unfortunately, we can't do much to help with the scene in question...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (But we can at least show our support for our friend.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'm worried for him as he works through this challenge...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But he's still the director of Wonderlands×Showtime! So, we should give him all the support we can!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah!
